instructions: For each item answer satisfied, not_satisfied, or unclear, judged only on the passages shown. Do not consult the source study or any automatic score.
purpose: supplement the calibration set after excluding six unclear items; the base form yielded nineteen decidable labels against a requirement of twenty-five

sampling.strata: judge confidence buckets >0.9, 0.7-0.9, <0.7 with task and condition spread
sampling.exclusions: the twenty-five items already labelled; only judge-scored elements are eligible
sampling.rationale: the same confidence stratification as the base form at the same proportions, so the supplement does not shift the composition of the set

candidate_passages: All items ... that have been scored by at least one human rater and one automatic rater under both the baseline rubric and the new variant rubric, under a paired (cross-over) design.
Sampling frame: Held-out artifact optimization tasks from Claude Code projects.
Scoring runs on the held-out evaluation set *outside* any candidate workspace. No scoring logic inside the harness.
Custom tasks will be versioned and released with reproducibility metadata.
used only for final measurement (never for in-workspace training or harness development)
Snapshot H₁ at two independent construction points (e.g., H₁^(first) and H₁^(second), created from two runs or two branches).
